# GroqCloud

GroqCloud provides high-performance AI inference services, enabling developers to deploy and manage AI models efficiently.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/groqcloud/.

## Actions

- **Create Audio Translation**: Translate an audio file into English text.
- **Create Chat Completion**: Generate a chat-based completion for a conversation.
- **List Models** (read-only): List all available models.
- **List TTS Voices** (read-only): Retrieve available TTS voices for Groq PlayAI models.
- **Retrieve Model** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific model.
